timeline.title: Start with a practical question
timeline.text: What would make a first step into IT feel clearer, warmer, and more achievable?

timeline.title: Build guided pathways
timeline.text: Schools and programmes are shaped around a visible progression from foundations to deeper capability.

timeline.title: Practise with purpose
timeline.text: Live guidance, replay, labs, and projects bring the learning model to life.

timeline.title: Keep the next step open
timeline.text: The academy grows toward a broader future-school model while keeping every claim evidence-led.

values: A real person, a clear route, and space to ask better questions.
Learning becomes useful when learners can practise and explain what they made.
We label what is confirmed, what is planned, and what is still being built.
Start small, build foundations, and keep a future pathway in sight.
